status: analysis exploration lock; not a model; no version assigned
purpose: use dense within-race relative-order labels to learn matchup-specific ability instead of sparse winning-ticket labels
trainingRows: every unordered pair of active finishers in each training race; orientation fixed by ascending horse number
target: 1 iff lower-horse-number member finishes ahead of the other; exact dead heats are excluded from pairwise binary fitting
pairFeatures: signed difference of all 193 runner features plus absolute difference of market log probability, market log-probability signed difference, surface/distance/class/field-size context already present in runner features

coldStart.rule: normalized JRA official win-market probability only; no learned pairwise ability

raceAbility: for each horse, average logit of predicted probability that it beats every other active runner; center within race; combine with normalized official win-market log probability by an equal fixed 0.5/0.5 log-score blend
jointDistribution: Plackett-Luce using exp(blended race ability score)

ticketProbabilities.quinella: sum of both ordered top-two probabilities
ticketProbabilities.wide: sum of ordered top-three outcomes containing both horses

ticketScore: strict-OOS joint probability multiplied by JRA official odds; wide uses lower bound
nextStageOnlyIfUseful: five-race selection and exact Light allocation must be locked separately before portfolio ROI evaluation
